title: Build a model to learn the embeddings

cues.en: Now we have the data organized so we can construct a deep learning model to train the embeddings matrix
cues.zh: 資料已整理好，現在可以建立深度學習模型，訓練嵌入矩陣，

cues.en: from being completely random numbers to being something that's a little more sensible.
cues.zh: 從完全隨機的數字，變成比較有意義的表示。

cues.en: Now, to be clear, what we are building in this video is not a language model.
cues.zh: 說清楚一點，這支影片建立的不是語言模型，

cues.en: I mean, technically it is a language model because it's a model that processes language.
cues.zh: 技術上，處理語言的模型也算語言模型，

cues.en: But this is not a transformer model like GPT or Bert.
cues.zh: 但不是 GPT 或 BERT 那樣的 Transformer。

cues.en: The entire purpose of this model is to train the embeddings matrix.
cues.zh: 整個目的，就是訓練嵌入矩陣。

cues.en: But why do we need an entire model just for one matrix?
cues.zh: 為什麼一個矩陣，卻需要整個模型？

cues.en: So the idea is that the embedding matrices are learned from text data.
cues.zh: 概念是，嵌入矩陣從文字資料學得，

cues.en: We use a larger deep learning model in which the embeddings are placed just to help train that matrix.
cues.zh: 把嵌入放進較大的深度學習模型，只為了幫助訓練這個矩陣。

cues.en: So I'm going to call this model the helper model.
cues.zh: 我把它叫作輔助模型。

cues.en: That's not an official term in the language modeling literature.
cues.zh: 這不是語言模型文獻中的正式術語，

cues.en: I'm just using it for the next few videos, just to make it clear that we're only using this model to
cues.zh: 只是接下來幾支影片使用，方便說明，這個模型只用來

cues.en: help us build the embeddings, we don't actually use it for any subsequent language modeling or text generation, as I will explain in a moment.
cues.zh: 幫助建立嵌入，後續語言建模或文字生成，不會使用它，稍後解釋。

cues.en: It wouldn't be possible to get the dense representations of tokens without adding additional help from a model architecture.
cues.zh: 如果沒有模型架構的額外協助，就無法取得 token 的稠密表示。

cues.en: In fact, we don't even care about the entire helper model once we've trained the embeddings matrix, the rest of the model is not used anymore.
cues.zh: 訓練好嵌入矩陣後，其實不在意整個輔助模型，其他部分不再使用。

cues.en: Part of the reason for this is that the embeddings are specific for a vocab size, which is good.
cues.zh: 一部分原因，是嵌入對應特定詞彙表大小，這很好，

cues.en: That's what we want, but the embeddings matrix itself does not depend on the context window or the number of tokens that the final language model can process.
cues.zh: 正是我們要的；但嵌入矩陣本身，不依賴上下文視窗，也就是最終語言模型能處理多少 token。

cues.en: So the embeddings matrix is just mapping one token at a time to its dense vector representation.
cues.zh: 它只是一次把一個 token，映射到稠密向量表示。

cues.en: On the other hand, the rest of the helper model that we'll use here for training the embeddings is actually entirely dependent on the sequence length that we choose.
cues.zh: 另一方面，這裡訓練嵌入用的輔助模型，其餘部分完全依賴所選的序列長度。

cues.en: So if we train an entire helper model using a sequence length of 20 tokens, then the embeddings matrix
cues.zh: 如果用長度 20 的序列訓練輔助模型，嵌入矩陣

cues.en: itself will still work for a sequence of 19 tokens, but the rest of the helper model will break.
cues.zh: 仍適用於長度 19 的序列，但輔助模型其他部分會出錯。

cues.en: Okay, I'm going to explain this in more detail on the next slide.
cues.zh: 下一張投影片，更詳細解釋。

cues.en: But the idea is that the hidden layers in the deep learning model squeeze the dimensionality, and that's
cues.zh: 概念是，深度學習模型的隱藏層壓縮維度，

cues.en: what forces the embeddings to learn dense representations of lots of tokens.
cues.zh: 迫使嵌入學會大量 token 的稠密表示。

cues.en: So here is what our deep learning model that we're going to build in this video looks like.
cues.zh: 這就是這支影片要建立的深度學習模型。

cues.en: We have an input layer here and an output layer over here.
cues.zh: 這裡是輸入層，這邊是輸出層。

cues.en: The size of the input and the size of the output are the same, which equals the number of words in our dictionary.
cues.zh: 輸入與輸出大小相同，等於字典的單字數。

cues.en: So based on the code that I wrote in the previous video, that's 4589 for GPT two.
cues.zh: 依上一支影片的程式，是 4589；如果是 GPT-2，

cues.en: That would be 50,257.
And what happens inside this model?
cues.zh: 模型裡發生什麼？

cues.en: Well, we have these hidden layers here that compress the dimensionality of the input space.
cues.zh: 隱藏層壓縮輸入空間的維度。

cues.en: So the embeddings matrix, which is visualized by these blue lines here is 4000 by 100.
cues.zh: 藍線表示嵌入矩陣，大小約 4000 乘以 100。

cues.en: Now why 100.
cues.zh: 為什麼是 100？

cues.en: Where does that number come from.
cues.zh: 這個數字從哪裡來？

cues.en: That's the arbitrary choice that I made for the embeddings dimensionality.
cues.zh: 這是我任意選的嵌入維度。

cues.en: As you know in GPT two that number is 768.
cues.zh: 如你所知，GPT-2 的這個數字是 768。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then we have this hidden layer connection here from 600 to 128.
cues.zh: 接著，隱藏層連接從 600 到 128，

cues.en: And then the output layer goes from 128 dimensions back to 4000.
cues.zh: 輸出層再從 128 維，回到約 4000。

cues.en: Now, how do you explain this mismatch here between 100 dimensions coming out of the embeddings, but 600 coming into the hidden layer?
cues.zh: 可是，嵌入輸出 100 維，隱藏層輸入卻是 600，這個不一致怎麼解釋？

cues.en: Does that make any sense?
cues.zh: 合理嗎？

cues.en: If you studied deep learning models before then you know that these two sizes must match.
cues.zh: 學過深度學習，就知道兩個大小必須相符。

cues.en: Because this here is representing a matrix that needs to calculate dot products with this matrix, and
cues.zh: 因為這裡表示一個矩陣，要與另一個矩陣計算內積，

cues.en: that matrix multiplication is only valid if the two sizes match.
cues.zh: 只有大小相符，矩陣乘法才有效。

cues.en: Okay, so I'd like you to think about this for a moment.
cues.zh: 請想一下。

cues.en: If you'd like some more time, feel free to pause the video.
cues.zh: 如果需要更多時間，可以暫停。

cues.en: So the answer is that I hard coded the sequence length to be six tokens.
cues.zh: 答案是，我把序列長度固定為六個 token。

cues.en: So what's coming into the embeddings is actually tokens by sequence length, which is six, and so 100 times six is 600.
cues.zh: 嵌入收到的是 token 序列，長度為 6，所以 100 乘以 6，就是 600。

cues.en: This is why the helper model is specific to a pre-chosen sequence length.
cues.zh: 因此，輔助模型只能對應預先選定的序列長度。

cues.en: Anyway, the idea is that this model has to learn to predict the next token in a sequence.
cues.zh: 總之，模型必須學會預測序列的下一個 token。

cues.en: Now, if we didn't have these hidden layers and it was just, you know, 4500 to 4500, then the mapping would be really simple.
cues.zh: 如果沒有隱藏層，直接 4500 到 4500，映射就很簡單。

cues.en: The model would basically just learn to associate one token with one unit.
cues.zh: 模型基本上，只會學到一個 token 對應一個單元。

cues.en: But that is not what we want.
cues.zh: 但這不是我們要的。

cues.en: We want a dense, low dimensional representation that incorporates some kind of semantic relationships
cues.zh: 我們想要稠密、低維的表示，包含某種語意關係，

cues.en: based on predictability and context and word associations.
cues.zh: 基於可預測性、上下文與單字關聯。

cues.en: So the idea is that we force this model to do next token prediction while squeezing the dimensionality inside the model, in this case by a factor of ten.
cues.zh: 所以，迫使模型做下一 token 預測，同時壓縮內部維度，這裡大約縮小十倍。

cues.en: So the model needs to learn compact, dense representations of the tokens.
cues.zh: 模型因此要學習精簡、稠密的 token 表示。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then after training we keep this blue matrix here and eventually attach this blue matrix to a real language model like GPT.
cues.zh: 訓練後，保留藍色矩陣，最後可把它接到 GPT 這類真正的語言模型。

cues.en: And by the way this model is not drawn to scale.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這張圖沒有按比例畫。

cues.en: Obviously the numbers here are correct, but the number of dots is just to facilitate visual interpretation.
cues.zh: 數字正確，但點的數量，只是幫助視覺理解。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: I'd like to say a few quick words about the dimensionality of the embedding space in the model that we're using here.
cues.zh: 簡單談談，這個模型的嵌入空間維度。

cues.en: I picked a dimensionality of 100 that's quite small for a language model.
cues.zh: 我選 100，對語言模型而言相當小。

cues.en: But of course our purpose here is to learn the mechanisms and implementations, not to build a real commercial application that's going to compete with OpenAI.
cues.zh: 但這裡是學機制與實作，不是要做出和 OpenAI 競爭的商業應用。

cues.en: But how do we pick the dimensionality in practice?
cues.zh: 實務上，怎麼挑維度？

cues.en: Well, a common guideline in the NLP or natural language processing literature is the square root of n, where n is the vocab size.
cues.zh: 自然語言處理，也就是 NLP 文獻中，常見準則是 n 的平方根，n 為詞彙表大小。

cues.en: So the idea here is that the larger the vocab, the bigger the embeddings space.
cues.zh: 概念是，詞彙表越大，嵌入空間也越大。

cues.en: But you don't want the embeddings dimensionality to grow too large, so you shrink it down by a square root factor.
cues.zh: 但不希望維度太大，所以用平方根縮小。

cues.en: So this is the kind of heuristic you'd see in like word to vec and glove, for example.
cues.zh: 例如 Word2Vec 與 GloVe，可能看到這類經驗法則。

cues.en: On the other hand, language models with transformers actually need a much higher dimensionality because
cues.zh: 另一方面，Transformer 語言模型，需要高得多的維度，因為

cues.en: the embedding dimension is not just for the initial token encoding, that embedding vector.
cues.zh: 嵌入維度不只用於初始 token 編碼，那個嵌入向量，

cues.en: That embedding space is literally used throughout the entire language model architecture.
cues.zh: 那個嵌入空間，會用在整個語言模型架構。

cues.en: So if the dimensionality of the embedding is too small from the beginning, then it's going to stay too small throughout the entire model.
cues.zh: 所以，一開始太小，整個模型裡都會太小。

cues.en: On the other hand, if it's gratuitously large, then it's going to eat up a lot more compute time and resources with no benefit or possibly even a decrement in performance.
cues.zh: 但如果大得沒必要，會耗更多計算與資源，沒有好處，甚至可能降低表現。

cues.en: So in practice, language models will choose a dimensionality that is considerably higher than the recommendation in the NLP literature, but not arbitrarily large.
cues.zh: 因此，實務上會選比 NLP 文獻建議高得多，但不任意大的維度。

cues.en: Uh, yeah.
cues.zh: 是的。

cues.en: This is the text that I basically just said.
cues.zh: 這段文字，基本上就是剛才說的。

cues.en: Okay, so here is a picture that illustrates this idea.
cues.zh: 這張圖，呈現這個概念。

cues.en: So what I've plotted here is the square root of the vocab size.
cues.zh: 畫的是詞彙表大小的平方根。

cues.en: Now following this heuristic, we would expect that GPT two has an embeddings dimension of a little
cues.zh: 依這個經驗法則，預期 GPT-2 嵌入維度，應略高於

cues.en: over 200 because that is the square root of 50,000.
cues.zh: 200，因為那是 50,000 的平方根。

cues.en: But in fact the gpt2 embedding dimensionality is closer to 800.
cues.zh: 但實際 GPT-2 嵌入維度，更接近 800。

cues.en: Hundred.
cues.zh: 八百。

cues.en: So here you see a screenshot of the OpenAI website where they discuss the embedding dimensionality of GPT three.
cues.zh: 這是 OpenAI 網站截圖，討論 GPT-3 的嵌入維度。

cues.en: Now, the main version of GPT three has a dimensionality of 3000.
cues.zh: GPT-3 的主要版本，有約 3000 維。

cues.en: And they also offer a version that is half that size for a smaller version of GPT three.
cues.zh: 也提供維度減半、較小的 GPT-3 版本。

cues.en: I will talk more about this later in the course, but language model developers will often release multiple versions of their model with varying sizes.
cues.zh: 之後會談，語言模型開發者常釋出多種不同大小的版本。

cues.en: So the idea is to make available smaller and lighter versions of the model that are easier to work with,
cues.zh: 目的是提供更小、更輕、容易操作的模型，

cues.en: uh, with ideally minimal decrease performance compared to the full versions.
cues.zh: 理想上，相較完整版，表現只略微降低。

cues.en: Anyway, so how do these companies come up with these numbers?
cues.zh: 這些公司怎麼決定數字？

cues.en: Honestly, this does not come from some well defined or sort of theoretically grounded mathematical formula.
cues.zh: 老實說，並不是來自明確、具有理論基礎的數學公式。

cues.en: Usually they just explore empirically several different embedding sizes, and then pick one that seems
cues.zh: 通常實際探索幾種嵌入大小，再挑一個

cues.en: to find the balance between efficiency, performance, and computation time.
cues.zh: 在效率、表現與計算時間之間取得平衡的值。

cues.en: Okay, so that's enough about the helper model and enough background information.
cues.zh: 輔助模型與背景，就談到這裡。

cues.en: Now I'm going to tell you about what we are going to do in the Python demo.
cues.zh: 接著，說明 Python 示範。

cues.en: We are going to start by creating a random embeddings matrix which looks like this.
cues.zh: 先建立隨機嵌入矩陣，像這樣。

cues.en: I've also plotted the embeddings vector for one randomly selected word.
cues.zh: 也畫出一個隨機單字的嵌入向量。

cues.en: In this case it happened to be steadfastly.
cues.zh: 這次，剛好是 steadfastly，堅定地。

cues.en: Remember that this text is from the Time Machine book, which was written like 150 years ago.
cues.zh: 記得，文字來自大約 150 年前寫的《時間機器》，

cues.en: So it's a little bit old fashioned.
cues.zh: 所以有點古老。

cues.en: But anyway, so here's a question.
cues.zh: 不過，有個問題。

cues.en: The words time and machine are going to be very strongly related to each other in this book.
cues.zh: 這本書裡，time 與 machine，關係應該非常密切。

cues.en: It's literally the title of the book and throughout the book, the words time and machine co-occur in close succession to each other.
cues.zh: 它們就是書名，而且整本書中，經常接連或相近地出現。

cues.en: So one of the things that we are going to explore here is whether the cosine similarity between the
cues.zh: 所以，要探索，根據《時間機器》訓練矩陣後，

cues.en: embedding vectors, between the word time and the word machine will increase after training the embeddings matrix on the Time machine book.
cues.zh: time 與 machine 嵌入向量的餘弦相似度，是否增加。

cues.en: Of course, this starts off being a completely untrained model with completely random weights.
cues.zh: 當然，一開始完全沒訓練，權重全部隨機。

cues.en: So we expect the cosine similarity in the beginning to be exactly zero.
cues.zh: 所以，預期最初餘弦相似度為 0。

cues.en: In fact, it's not going to be literally exactly zero because we have limited sample size and noise and so on.
cues.zh: 實際不會精確為 0，因為樣本有限、還有雜訊等等。

cues.en: And furthermore, each time you run the code, you're going to generate new embeddings vectors.
cues.zh: 而且，每次執行程式，都產生新的嵌入向量，

cues.en: So this number will always change.
cues.zh: 所以，數字一直會變。

cues.en: But anyway what we are going to do is store this number before and after training and then see what happens.
cues.zh: 總之，儲存訓練前後的數值，再看變化。

cues.en: Of course, training happens in a later video.
cues.zh: 訓練會在後面的影片。

cues.en: But what I would like you to do is make a prediction about what the result might be.
cues.zh: 但希望你先預測結果。

cues.en: And let me already give you a hint.
cues.zh: 先給個提示：

cues.en: It's not necessarily as simple as what you want the answer to be.
cues.zh: 答案不一定像你希望的那麼簡單。

cues.en: Anyway, then we are going to build the model.
cues.zh: 接著，建立模型。

cues.en: Here is a screenshot of the code that generates the class for the model.
cues.zh: 這是產生模型類別的程式截圖。

cues.en: So here I am initializing the embeddings matrix using KNN embedding.
cues.zh: 用 nn.Embedding 初始化嵌入矩陣。

cues.en: Here are the two linear layers that I showed in the visual depiction of the model a few slides ago.
cues.zh: 這是幾張投影片前，模型圖中的兩個線性層。

cues.en: And you can already see here that this first linear layer is the embedding dimensionality times the context window the sequence length size.
cues.zh: 可以看到，第一個線性層的輸入，是嵌入維度乘以上下文視窗，也就是序列長度。

cues.en: And then yeah again I'm specifying that to be six.
cues.zh: 同樣，指定為 6。

cues.en: So you don't see that in this screenshot.
cues.zh: 這張截圖看不到，

cues.en: But you'll see it in the code.
cues.zh: 但程式裡會看到。

cues.en: I would like you to call back into memory.
cues.zh: 請回想，

cues.en: The diagram of the model from a few slides ago.
cues.zh: 幾張投影片前的模型圖，

cues.en: And think about how these lines of code here map onto that model.
cues.zh: 思考這些程式行如何對應模型。

cues.en: Anyway, I'll have more things to say about this model construction and the forward method here when I switch to code.
cues.zh: 切換到程式後，會進一步說明模型建構與 forward 方法。

cues.en: Okay, next we will test the model just by pushing a little bit of data through and making sure that it prints out valid results.
cues.zh: 接著，送一點資料進模型，確認能印出有效結果，做測試。

cues.en: Now this model is so far untrained, so we don't expect anything sensible here.
cues.zh: 目前模型沒訓練，不預期輸出有意義。

cues.en: The goal of this model test is just to see whether we have any errors when running the feed forward
cues.zh: 測試只想知道，前向

cues.en: sweep of the model, and if we already have errors here, then there's no point in moving forward until we fix those errors.
cues.zh: 傳遞是否出錯；如果這裡出錯，就該先修好，再繼續。

cues.en: Also, we can confirm that the sum of the outputs brings us to a value of one when converted into probability values and softmax.
cues.zh: 也能確認，透過 softmax 轉成機率後，輸出加總為 1。

cues.en: I'll talk about this more in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片，會詳細談。

cues.en: But basically we're going to use a log likelihood loss function that expects the outputs in this numerical format.
cues.zh: 基本上，要使用對數概似損失，它預期這種數值格式的輸出。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Next we are going to generate text from this model.
cues.zh: 接著，讓模型產生文字。

cues.en: And that's going to produce an output that looks something like this.
cues.zh: 輸出會像這樣。

cues.en: So we will provide some input to this model for example at the time machine.
cues.zh: 例如，給模型這個輸入：at the time machine，

cues.en: Happily then and then each of these rows here correspond to processing steps by the model.
cues.zh: happily then。這裡每列，對應模型的一步處理。

cues.en: And what you see is that they're all shifted versions of the preceding line.
cues.zh: 每列，都是上一列平移後的版本。

cues.en: So this model is generating new text by taking the previous line of text, dropping the first token and adding a new token at the end.
cues.zh: 模型取得前一列文字，丟掉第一個 token，再在尾端加一個新 token，產生文字。

cues.en: At some point, the token sequence has shifted such that the original input is no longer present, and
cues.zh: 到某個時刻，序列持續平移，最初輸入不再存在，

cues.en: then we get what the model would print out if you're interacting with a chatbot.
cues.zh: 就得到與聊天機器人互動時，它會印出的文字。

cues.en: Of course, this is still an untrained model, so we don't expect anything sensible, but we certainly don't hope to see any errors here.
cues.zh: 當然，仍然沒訓練，所以不預期有意義，但希望不要出錯。

cues.en: Okay.

cues.en: Okay, I said that was the final thing, but I forgot that there is a final, final thing which is to get a summary of the model.
cues.zh: 剛才說是最後一件事，但忘了還有真正最後一件：取得模型摘要。

cues.en: So here we see the entire helper model.
cues.zh: 這裡是整個輔助模型。

cues.en: This is the embeddings matrix that we want to train.
cues.zh: 這是要訓練的嵌入矩陣，

cues.en: It has almost half a million parameters.
cues.zh: 將近 50 萬個參數。

cues.en: And these are the two linear layers that are tied to the sequence length.
cues.zh: 這兩個線性層，則依賴序列長度。

cues.en: We don't care about them.
cues.zh: 我們不在意它們，

cues.en: We are going to delete them once we finish training the model.
cues.zh: 訓練完成後會刪除。

cues.en: One more thing before I give a summary is just to make sure it's really clear how this model diagram maps onto the code.
cues.zh: 總結前，還想確認，模型圖與程式的對應很清楚。

cues.en: So all of these blue lines here correspond to this line of code here.
cues.zh: 所有藍線，對應這行程式。

cues.en: And this hidden box over here corresponds to this line of code.
cues.zh: 這個隱藏層方框，對應這行。

cues.en: And this orange box corresponds to this line of code.
cues.zh: 橘色方框，則對應這行。

cues.en: Remember that in deep learning implementations, we often think about the white circles here as the
cues.zh: 深度學習實作中，常把白色圓圈視為

cues.en: neurons or units that are the elementary computational units.
cues.zh: 神經元或單元，也就是基本計算單位。

cues.en: And that is kind of true.
cues.zh: 這大致沒錯。

cues.en: But in implementation we don't actually define those units explicitly.
cues.zh: 但實作時，並不明確定義這些單元，

cues.en: Instead, what we define is the matrices that connect the different layers, which are here visually represented as these lines.
cues.zh: 而是定義各層之間的連接矩陣，視覺上，以這些線表示。

cues.en: I hope you found this video interesting and enlightening.
cues.zh: 希望你覺得這支影片有趣、有啟發。

cues.en: The choice of embedding dimension is tricky and also important.
cues.zh: 嵌入維度的選擇，很棘手，也很重要。

cues.en: It's a hyper parameter of the language model and if you get it wrong, then the entire language model suffers.
cues.zh: 它是語言模型的超參數，選錯，整個模型都會受影響。

cues.en: So you also learned in this video more about how language models generate text.
cues.zh: 這支影片，也學到更多語言模型如何產生文字，

cues.en: In particular, the models will look at the entire sequence of input tokens, drop the first one and make a prediction about adding a new one at the end.
cues.zh: 尤其是看完整輸入 token 序列、去掉第一個，再預測新的 token，加到尾端。

cues.en: And then it keeps going through that iteratively, over and over and over again for however many new tokens you want.
cues.zh: 接著，反覆迭代，直到產生想要數量的新 token。
